overviewDescription: Manage your organization, access, and notification activity.
workspaceDescription: Build your organization, bring in your team, and define their roles.
sessionNote: These details are for display. The server checks permission for every operation.
tenantsDescription: Manage platform tenants and their lifecycle.
org-unitsDescription: Create, rename, and move units within your organization.
usersDescription: Manage your team's accounts and role assignments.
rolesDescription: Define tenant roles and their permission sets.
notificationsDescription: Review masked email history and delivery attempts.
sample-itemsDescription: Create a sample service record or retrieve one by its identifier.
loginDescription: Enter your tenant and account details to continue.
authDescription: People, organizations, and access. Together, securely.
registerDescription: Create an account within an existing tenant.
registerSuccess: Your account was created. You can now sign in.
changePasswordDescription: Changing your password ends every session. Sign in again with your new password.
passwordRequired: You need to change your password to continue.
confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this record?
deleteDescription: This deletes the record on the server. Related records may prevent deletion.
emptyDescription: Records will appear here once they are created.
networkError: The server response could not be read. Check your connection and gateway configuration, then try again.
temporaryError: Permission information is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
conflict: Another operation changed this record. Open the latest version and review your changes again.
name: Name
title: Title
assignmentsHint: This list replaces all of the user's role assignments. An empty list removes all roles.
statisticsNote: SMTP acceptance does not mean delivery. Statistics cover the server's stated date range.
authExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
activationConfirm: Are you sure you want to change the active status of this account?
forgotPasswordDescription: Passwords are reset by an administrator of your tenant. Contact them and ask for a temporary password; you will be asked to choose a new one when you sign in.
resetPasswordDescription: Set a temporary password. The user's sessions end and they must choose a new password at next sign-in.
renderError: The screen could not be displayed. Reload the page to try again.
